global: Stacked {gold} in the coffers and {troop_count} men under arms. Now I just need someone to tell me what to spend it on.
Our banners flew over {fief} again today. My old sergeant would have called that a fine morning, and so do I.
Pardon the grin, but {troop_count} soldiers marching in step is a sight I never tire of.
Back in the first war we counted our wins on one hand. Now I need the other hand just for the coin purse.
Honest truth: {gold} sounds grand until the garrison comes asking for its wages. Enjoy it while the ledger is kind.
Good to see the young crews pulling their weight. Keep the cheering down, though. The ones who lost are still reading.
I will admit {troop_count} men is impressive. I will not admit I counted them twice to be sure.
Took {fief} with a smaller force than I expected. Patience and a dry powder keg did most of the talking.
Wealth buys a lot of swords, but it cannot buy a good night's sleep. Ask me how I know.
Congratulations on the spoils, truly. Just remember the fens still swallow careless folk, rich or not.
